mapper.insert: insert into CHB_SEC_REPAY_INFO(SEC_ID,REPAY_DT,SEC_NM,REPAY_RATE,REPAY_NET,TRADE_MARKET, REPAY_CYCLE_DAY, REPAY_MODE) SELECT T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID SEC_ID, T3.VDATE REPAY_DT, T1.FINPROD_ABBR SEC_NM, T3.PRIN_AMT REPAY_RATE, 100 - (SELECT SUM(PRIN_AMT) FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN WHERE CASH_ID = T3.CASH_ID AND VDATE <= T3.VDATE) AS REPAY_NET, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T3.MDATE REPAY_CYCLE_DAY, 1 AS REPAY_MODE FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1, FIN_CASH_INFO T2, FIN_CASH_PLAN T3 WHERE T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' AND T3.CASH_TYPE IN ('02', '03') AND T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T2.CASH_ID = T3.CASH_ID
mapper.update:
UPDATE REP_ASSET_DEPT SET IS_REP_TARGET = 'Y' , UPDATE_TIME = #{updateTime} WHERE( REP_FINPROD_ID IN ( SELECT T1.REP_FINPROD_ID FROM REP_ASSET_DEPT T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT T3.FINPROD_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T3 ) T2 ON T1.REP_FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T2.FINPROD_ID IS NOT NULL )
or REP_FINPROD_ID IN (SELECT distinct T1.P_FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT T3.FINPROD_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T3) T2 ON (T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T2.FINPROD_ID IS NOT NULL) where T1.P_FINPROD_ID is not null )
or REP_FINPROD_ID IN ( SELECT distinct T1.FINPROD_ID FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB T1 where t1.FINPROD_ID is not null ) ) and (IS_REP_TARGET is null or IS_REP_TARGET != 'Y')
